articles.summary: PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFSI) today reported net income of $106.8 million for the fourth quarter of 2025, or $1.97 per share on a diluted basis, on total net revenues of $538.0 million. Book value per share increased to $82.77 from $81.12 at September 30, 2025. PFSI’s Board of Directors declared a fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.30 per share, payable on February 26, 2026, to common stockholders of record as of February 16, 2026.
